# alpha diversity
```{r}
physeq_alpha_div <- microbiome::alpha(physeq, index = "all")

# separate out the metadata from physeq
physeq_meta <- meta(physeq)

# add the sample names to diversity results
physeq_alpha_div$Sample_id <- rownames(physeq_alpha_div)
# merge
physeq_alpha_div <- merge(physeq_alpha_div,physeq_meta, by = "Sample_id")

physeq_alpha_div$Race <- physeq_alpha_div$race

write.csv(physeq_alpha_div, '../Output/physeq_alpha_div.csv')
```

#Fig. 1
```{r}
# merge a div shannon figs

# countinure from tsv
physeq_alpha_div <- read.csv('../Output/physeq_alpha_div.csv')

# exchange labels 

# merge a figs
theme_unified <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, vjust = 1.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
  )
#================= age shannon continue corr ===============
cor_res <- cor.test(
  physeq_alpha_div$diversity_shannon,
  physeq_alpha_div$age_MBC_dx,
  method = "spearman"
)

r_val <- round(cor_res$estimate, 3)
p_val <- cor_res$p.value
p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 2)))

p_age_shannon_cor <- ggplot(
  physeq_alpha_div,
  aes(x = age_MBC_dx, y = diversity_shannon)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75, color = "#4C72B0") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "#9A0000", fill = "grey85", linewidth = 1) +
   annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("Spearman R = ", r_val, "\n", p_label),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3)  +
  labs(
    x = "Age at MBC diagnosis",
    y = "Shannon diversity",
    #title = "Relationship between Age and Shannon diversity"
  ) +
  theme_unified


p_age_shannon_cor
ggsave('../Output/Plots/p_age_shannon_cor.pdf',p_age_shannon_cor, width = 5, height = 4)

# 4 factors shannon plots
#================shannon age group  -- 2 groups ===============
stat_test_age <- physeq_alpha_div %>%
  wilcox_test(diversity_shannon ~ age_group, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
  mutate(p = sprintf("%.2f", p)) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "age_group")
# # t test, no sig
# stat_test_age <- physeq_alpha_div %>%
#   t_test(diversity_shannon ~ age_group, var.equal = FALSE) %>%
#   add_xy_position(x = "age_group")

n_labels <- physeq_alpha_div %>%
  count(age_group) %>%
  mutate(lbl = paste0(age_group, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))
lab_map <- setNames(n_labels$lbl, n_labels$age_group)


p_age_shannon2 <- ggplot(physeq_alpha_div, aes(x = age_group, y = diversity_shannon, fill = age_group)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = age_group), width = 0.15, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.35, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 2.5,
               color = "black", fill = "white") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test_age,
    label = "p",        
    tip.length = 0.01
  )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_map) +
  labs(
    y = "Shannon diversity",
    x = "Age at MBC diagnosis"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("<50" = "#D5A021", ">=50" = "#6C4E09")) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("<50" = "#D5A021", ">=50" = "#6C4E09")) +
  theme_unified

p_age_shannon2
ggsave('../Output/Plots/p_age_shannon2.pdf',p_age_shannon2, width = 6, height = 4)

#================shannon race group  ===============
stat_test_race <- physeq_alpha_div %>%
  wilcox_test(diversity_shannon ~ race, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
    mutate(p = sprintf("%.2f", p)) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "race")
# # t test, no sig
# stat_test_age <- physeq_alpha_div %>%

  count(race) %>%
  mutate(lbl = paste0(race, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))
lab_map <- setNames(n_labels$lbl, n_labels$race)

p_race_shannon2 <- ggplot(physeq_alpha_div, aes(x = race, y = diversity_shannon, fill = race)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = race), width = 0.15, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.35, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 2.5,
               color = "black", fill = "white") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test_race,
    label = "p",        
    tip.length = 0.01
  )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_map) +

    y = "Shannon diversity",
    x = "Race"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Black" = "#83B4E1", "White" = "#1F5A97")) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("Black" = "#83B4E1", "White" = "#1F5A97")) +

p_race_shannon2
ggsave('../Output/Plots/p_race_shannon2.pdf',p_race_shannon2, width = 6, height = 4)

p_ER_shannon2

#================shannon CTC group  ===============
physeq_alpha_div2 <- physeq_alpha_div %>%
  mutate(
    ctc2 = case_when(
      CTC_count_cat %in% c("0", "0-5") ~ "0–5",
      CTC_count_cat %in% c(">5")  ~ ">5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctc2))
physeq_alpha_div2$ctc2 <- factor(physeq_alpha_div2$ctc2,
  levels = c("0–5", ">5"))

stat_test_ctc <- physeq_alpha_div2 %>% 
  wilcox_test(diversity_shannon ~ ctc2, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
      mutate(p = sprintf("%.2f", p)) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "ctc2")
# # t test, no sig
# stat_test_age <- physeq_alpha_div %>%
#   t_test(diversity_shannon ~ age_group, var.equal = FALSE) %>%
#   add_xy_position(x = "age_group")

n_labels <- physeq_alpha_div2 %>%
  count(ctc2) %>%
  mutate(lbl = paste0(ctc2, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))
lab_map <- setNames(n_labels$lbl, n_labels$ctc2)

p_ctc_shannon2 <- ggplot(physeq_alpha_div2, aes(x = ctc2, y = diversity_shannon, fill = ctc2)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = ctc2), width = 0.15, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.35, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 2.5,
               color = "black", fill = "white") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test_ctc,
    label = "p",        
    tip.length = 0.01
  )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_map) +
  labs(
    y = "Shannon diversity",
    x = "CTCs categories"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0–5" = "#F7A280", ">5" = "#B33C1E")) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("0–5" = "#F7A280", ">5" = "#B33C1E")) +
  theme_unified

p_ctc_shannon2
ggsave('../Output/Plots/p_ctc_shannon2.pdf',p_ctc_shannon2, width = 6, height = 4)

library(patchwork)

a_div_plot <- p_age_shannon_cor +

a_div_plot
